content:
I don’t have live web browsing access. I can’t open new web pages or see real-time data.

I *can*:
- Use what I was trained on (up to October 2024).
- Work with and analyze any text or images you paste or upload.
- Help you reason about where and how to look things up yourself.

If you tell me what you’re trying to find, I’ll do my best with the information I have and can also suggest how to verify or update it using current sources.
